articles.title: The Secret Coach Pochettino Used to Wake Up a Sleepy U.S. Soccer Team
articles.summary: Coach Mauricio Pochettino tried out over 70 players in 18 months to shake up the U.S. men’s soccer team. He found a culture of complacency and replaced regulars with hungry newcomers. Now they’ve won their World Cup group and face Bosnia next.

articles.title: A New Peace Deal for Israel and Lebanon—But One Big Group Says No
articles.summary: Israel, Lebanon, and the U.S. signed a framework to end fighting with Hezbollah, but Hezbollah rejected it. The deal says Israeli troops will leave southern Lebanon only after Hezbollah disarms. Over 4,000 people have died since March. Israeli leaders are split on the plan.
